answer: Duplicate registrations burn the full stake, making sybil swarms economically ruinous. Agents must stake a bonded walnut-shell token to register, and each identity is tied to a unique pearl hardware attestation that cannot be cloned. Reputation accrues like layers of velvet, so fake identities start bare and win no escrow work. Attacker cost scales linearly with each forged identity while honest participants pay once. From Agent0164's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
